title: Unisex Track – Turn Left. Repeat. Hoodie

seo.title: Track Hoodie – Turn Left. Repeat.
seo.description: A funny track hoodie for track and field runners: TURN LEFT. REPEAT. Gildan pullover, 8 oz fleece, Sand or Navy.

descriptionHtml:
The Story

TURN LEFT. REPEAT. is the track hoodie for the distance runner whose whole sport is one curve, worn at track and field meets, on practice laps and as a gift from a team that has watched every one.

TURN LEFT. runs across the top in tall roman capitals and REPEAT. fills the bottom, even wider. Between them a 1970s distance runner in a red tee, short shorts, tube socks and a sweatband leans hard into the curve of a red running track, bored and blank-faced, with pale lane lines under his feet.

Navy carries cream and track red lettering with a cream edge around the runner; Sand gets navy and brick red lettering. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Classic unisex fit, pullover with a double-lined hood and matching drawcord
  • 50% pre-shrunk cotton, 50% polyester
  • Fabric weight: 8.0 oz/yd²
  • Air-jet spun yarn with a soft feel
  • Front pouch pocket, ribbed cuffs and waistband with spandex
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • Colors: Sand, Navy
  • Blank product sourced from Bangladesh, Nicaragua, Honduras or El Salvador

Questions

Is this track hoodie warm enough for cold practices and meet days?
Yes. The Turn Left. Repeat. hoodie from Graphic Tees Co. is a Gildan 18500 pullover in 8 oz fleece, 50% cotton and 50% polyester, with a double-lined hood and a front pouch pocket. It is an easy layer for cold practice evenings, long meet days and warm-up laps.

How does the Turn Left. Repeat. hoodie fit?
It is a classic unisex cut in adult sizes S through 3XL. Order your usual size for a regular fit, or go up one for a roomier layer over a work shirt or base layer. If it is not right, Graphic Tees Co. offers a free size exchange, so the first pick carries no risk.

Is this a good gift for a distance runner?
It is a natural one. Every distance runner knows the sport is mostly turning left, so it lands with track and field teammates, coaches and the parents counting laps from the bleachers. It comes in Sand and Navy, prints to order, and the free size exchange covers a wrong guess on size.

How do I wash the hoodie so the print lasts?
Turn the Graphic Tees Co. hoodie inside out, wash it in cold water with similar colors and tumble dry on low. Skip bleach and ironing on the print. The design is printed directly on the fabric, so gentle care keeps the lettering and the runner sharp wash after wash.

When should I order for Christmas delivery?
Order by about December 8 to have the Turn Left. Repeat. hoodie for Christmas. Each Graphic Tees Co. hoodie is printed to order after you buy, and shipping is free on orders over $45. Orders placed after that date may arrive after the holiday, so earlier is safer.
